searchText: What's the solution to the missed slot problem? Is there a way to ask the relays to block Titan Builder until their issue is fixed and then announce to the staking community which relays have done so so that we can enable those only? the first part is supposed to happen automatically What would be the reason for that failing? Lack of implementation/testing, etc? Every time it's happened it's been different in its specifics, so this is something that I'd like to hear from the relays rather than speculating -- place here that line that I kept repeating for the last couple of years -- Does ePBS fix this? Yes, clients will circuit break Titan and not other builders. There's an argument that "rational" validators will fork clients to avoid this circuit breaking... I'm not going to get into that discussion Hasn't stopped/been fixed so far block 23313471 (0x5a5521e0faa69da6a77f2ff0764f4d0f102308dd3cd8f66828b7984a6099b414) is invalid ExtraData: Titan (titanbuilder.xyz)
